elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly states that Customer is not subject to any non-solicitation, no-hire, or similar restriction regarding Vendor personnel.
No mutual non-solicitation restriction is created; Section 12.4 instead removes any such restriction from Customer.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: There is no operative non-solicitation restriction with a scope limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: There is no operative restriction or 12-month period tied to the end of a person's involvement.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Although Section 12.3 protects Customer's hiring of persons responding to general recruitment, no mutual restriction contains a general-advertising carve-out.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: No operative language establishes an unsolicited-approach carve-out within a mutual non-solicitation restriction.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly eliminates any no-hire restriction on Customer, and no hiring prohibition is imposed on Vendor.
